Off-peak good news for families
With that in mind
Travelers, here is the plain reminder you need before bringing a pet to the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.

Please keep travel papers ready, make sure the carrier is secure, and stay close while the staff checks each detail. The team will move carriers carefully between services, so do not open a crate or swap items without asking first. That keeps the process calm for the animal and smooth for everyone waiting nearby.

The passenger coordinator will guide you through the required steps and point out anything missing before the pet can move on. If your travel plans change, tell the desk right away so the file stays accurate and the ground team can keep working without delay. Clear labels, tidy paperwork, and calm handling all help the day run better.

Bring only the items approved for the trip, and keep food, water, and comfort gear packed in the way the desk asks for. Small delays add up fast, so check your bag before you arrive and give the staff enough room to do the job properly. Travelers should expect close attention, careful checks, and steady movement from one stage to the next.

Please go to the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways for help before your pet travels.
